meta.title: Ortsrank – In which municipalities are you behind your competitors?
meta.description: For businesses serving a region: Google visibility municipality by municipality, competitors and evidence-backed priorities for where to start.

hero.title: In which municipalities are you behind your competitors?
hero.lead: Ortsrank measures your Google visibility in the municipalities of your service area and shows where to start – with evidence for every recommendation.

items.title: Municipalities from the official register
items.text: Based on the Destatis municipality register. Each municipality is measured from one representative point; municipalities we cannot measure are marked as such.

items.title: Organic, ads, Local Pack
items.text: Three result types tracked separately – with time, device and measuring point for every number.

items.title: Who covers your service area
items.text: In how many municipalities each competitor ranks ahead – local businesses separated from chains and portals.

items.title: Priorities with evidence
items.text: Every recommendation shows what it rests on: observation, inference or a hypothesis to verify.
